description: This is a shell script that manages Quality of Service (QoS) configurations on OpenWrt. It loads and executes various functions, manipulates network interfaces, parses configuration files, and sets up iptables rules to control network traffic prioritization and shaping.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Loads kernel modules with handling for different `insmod` commands.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds the network interface name for a given interface, or reports an error if not found.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Constructs iptables match rules based on a variety of network parameters and configuration options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Handles initial configuration parsing, setting default values and class groups.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration entries, defining interface and class configurations.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates and assigns numbers to QoS classes based on configuration.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Sets class variables like packet size, delay, rate, etc., from config.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules via awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes traffic shaping on a specific network interface based on configuration.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts traffic shaping on all configured interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for QoS classification based on provided rules.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Sets up class groups with iptables rules and traffic control qdiscs.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Initializes QoS firewall rules across all configured interfaces and class groups.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Clears QoS iptables chains and rules, resetting firewall to default state.
